name: Dev Tools
description: Runs offline in a sandbox with zero network calls and just a single local permission. 44 developer utilities in under 200KB: an all-in-one toolkit covering crypto & security, encoding, text & regex, time & Cron, network & DevOps, and frontend assets — built for everyday development needs.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 沙箱离线运行，零联网、仅1项本地权限。44 款开发工具小于 200KB：集安全加解密、编解码与转义、文本与正则排版、时间与 Cron 计算、网络与系统运维、前端图像与标识生成等全场景工具于一体，满足日常开发高频需求。
